methodology.statistics: Median and nearest-rank p95; raw samples retained.
methodology.cold: Fresh service/page/module workloads; OS disk caches are not flushed.
methodology.browser: Production React bundle; synthetic Git host to isolate UI cost. Native-host Git costs measured separately.
methodology.nativeHost: Actual plugin bundle through an Obsidian API shim; metadata serialization writes a real temporary file.
methodology.thresholds: Targets for this audit, not universal guarantees. Browser timings include two animation frames to reach paint.

coverage: Production browser: initial paint, layer/layout/scope switching, stash/file search, navigation, full context, collapse, annotation save/resolve, viewed progress, clipboard/Markdown/export, six embeds, repeated mount/unmount and heap, 1x/4x CPU.
